title: China's trade surplus soars past US$1 trillion as AI boom powers exports
paragraphs: China's trade surplus soars past US$1 trillion as AI boom powers exports
Exports rose sharply by 35.2 per cent in October from the same month last year, helping to lift China's trade surplus to US$1.04 trillion in the first 10 months.

BEIJING: China's trade surplus surged past US$1 trillion in the first 10 months as a global race to build AI infrastructure buoyed sales of high-tech products and helped offset weak domestic demand, a dynamic likely to sharpen tensions with major trading partners.
